cases.prompt: Find a self-hosted open-source RAG system with Docker, a web UI, and clear commercial-use evidence.
expects: state that license evidence is not legal advice
forbids: invoke an AI Workstation server-side model

cases.prompt: Find the best open-source AI knowledge-base project for my company.
expects: state that live evidence is unavailable
provide a requirements and verification checklist
provide a candidate-evaluation matrix without current project facts
point to AI Open Source Radar for manual browsing
forbids: name a current winner from model memory
fall back to an AI Workstation server-side model

cases.prompt: Compare Dify and RAGFlow for a private enterprise knowledge base, prioritizing document processing, operational complexity, and license evidence.
expects: compare records from one compatible snapshot
keep factual matrix cells separate from recommendations
forbids: use popularity as a verified fact
hide a hard conflict in an aggregate score

cases.prompt: Build me a complete open-source RAG and Agent stack.
expects: state that live project evidence is unavailable
provide role selection criteria and acceptance tests
forbids: use an AI Workstation publisher model as fallback

cases.prompt: 找支持私有部署、Docker、中文文档问答和 Web 界面的开源项目，最好少写代码，并核验许可证。
expects: 保留少写代码的偏好极性
明确许可证结论不是法律意见
forbids: 调用 AI Workstation 网站大模型

cases.prompt: Dify 和 RAGFlow 到底谁更强？
expects: 先定义比较场景和标准
项目事实单元格保持未知
提供需要核验的来源和测试
forbids: 回退调用 AI Workstation 服务器模型

cases.prompt: 给 100 人公司设计可私有部署的中文内部知识库技术栈，需要权限、审计和 Docker 部署。
expects: 兼容性保持未核验状态
给出最高风险集成测试
forbids: 把组件组合当成已验证事实

cases.prompt: 找一个只能使用云服务、同时必须完全离线、并且不能进行任何本地安装的开源 AI 项目。
expects: 接近项必须显示唯一阻断条件
forbids: 调用网站大模型制造一个答案
